description: Where the time making thumbnails goes: requests and how many come from the store, each stage of making one, the render slots, the store, and ffmpeg.

panels.title: From the store
panels.description: Share of thumbnails served that were already made. Low while a new folder is being looked at for the first time.

panels.title: Making one (p95)
panels.description: How long the slowest 5% of requests for a thumbnail that had to be made took, waiting for a slot included.

panels.title: Waiting for a slot
panels.description: Thumbnails waiting now for one of the render slots.

panels.title: Render slots in use
panels.description: One thumbnail is made per CPU at a time. At 100% the rest wait.

panels.title: Store size
panels.description: The thumbnail database's file. Nothing is evicted. Empty when thumbnails are kept in memory. Alert: GowebserverThumbnailStoreLarge.

panels.title: Requests by result
panels.description: cached: it was in the store. made: for this request. unsupported: not a file a thumbnail can be made of. failed. canceled: the client left first.

panels.title: Work thrown away
panels.description: Abandoned thumbnails are ones every request left while they were being made, as when a grid is scrolled past: a decode that can't be interrupted still runs to its end.

panels.title: Photo stages (p95)
panels.description: wait: for a render slot. decode: the photo. scale. encode. store. Alert: GowebserverThumbnailBacklog when wait is above 5 s.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (stage, le) (rate(thumbnail_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", kind="photo"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Video stages (p95)
panels.description: decode is ffmpeg taking the frame, and for a video in an archive, copying it out first.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (stage, le) (rate(thumbnail_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", kind="video"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Where the time goes
panels.description: Seconds spent in each stage per second. Everything but wait is a render slot in use.

panels.title: Render slots
panels.description: Running can't pass the number of slots, one per CPU. Waiting above zero for long means more thumbnails are asked for than the CPUs can make.

panels.title: Source size
panels.description: Megapixels of the pictures decoded. Decoding time and memory follow this.

panels.title: Made ahead
panels.description: Thumbnails made ahead in the subfolders of folders being browsed (thumbnails.prefetch), by result. Cached ones were in the store already; canceled ones were thrown away when another folder was listed.

panels.title: Store lookups
panels.description: Every thumbnail request asks the store first.

panels.title: Store growth
panels.description: Bytes of thumbnails put in the store.

panels.title: ffmpeg runs by outcome
panels.description: A video can take several runs: a frame, then its length when there was no frame. A video in an archive is piped to ffmpeg, and when that fails (an MP4 with its index at the end) it is copied out and read as a file. Alert: GowebserverFFmpegTimeouts.

panels.title: Videos copied out of archives
panels.description: Bytes written to temporary files so ffmpeg could seek in them.

title: gowebserver thumbnails
